arabic_text: فَلَم يَبْتَدِرْنابِعُقُوبَتِه وَلَمْ يُعَاجِلْنَا بِنِقْمَتِهِ بَلْ تَانَّانا بِرَحْمَتِهِ تَكَرُّماً، وَانْتَظَرَ مُراجَعَتَنَا بِرَأفَتِهِ حِلْماً.
transliteration: falamma yabtadhirna bi-'uqubatihi wa-lam yu'ajilna bi-niqmatihi bal tānānā bi-raḥmatihi takarrumān, wa-antazara murājaʿatanā bi-raʾfatihī ḥilmā
english_text: Yet He hurried us not to His punishment,nor hastened us on to His vengeance, , No, He went slowly with us through His mercy, in generosity, and awaited our return through His clemency, in mildness.

arabic_text: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي دَلَّنَاعَلَى التَّوْبَةِ الَّتِي لَمْ نُفِدْهَا إلاّ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
transliteration: wa al-ḥamdu lillāh al-ladhī dallanā ʿalā al-tawbah allatī lam nufidhā illā min fadlihī
english_text: Praise belongs to God, who showed us the way to repentance, which we would not have won save through His bounty.

arabic_text: فَلَوْ لَمْ نَعْتَدِدْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إلاّ بِهَالَقَدْ حَسُنَ بَلاؤُهُ عِنْدَنَا، وَ جَلَّ إحْسَانُهُ إلَيْنَا، وَ جَسُمَ فَضْلُهُ عَلَيْنَا
transliteration: falaw lam naʿtadid min fadlihi 'illā bihāl-qad ḥasuna balā'uhu 'indanā wa jalla iḥsānuhu ilaynā wa jasuma faḍluhu ʿalaynā
english_text: Had we nothing to count as His bounty but this, His trial of us would have been good, His beneficence toward us great, His bounty upon us immense.

arabic_text: فَمَا هكذا كَانَتْ سُنَّتُهُ فِي التَّوْبَةِ لِمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَنَا
transliteration: famā hakaḏā kānat sunnatuhu fī at-tawba liman kana qablanā
english_text: For such was not His wont in repentance with those who went before us.

arabic_text: لَقَدْ وَضَعَ عَنَّا مَا لا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ، وَلَمْ يُكَلِّفْنَا إلاّ وُسْعاً، وَ لَمْ يُجَشِّمْنَا إلاّ يُسْراً
transliteration: laqad waḍaʿa ʿannā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih walam yukallifna illa wusʿan wa lam yujashshimna illa yusraً
english_text: He has lifted up from us "what we have not the strength to bear"(2:286) , charged us only to our capacity, imposed upon us nothing but ease,

arabic_text: وَلَمْ يَدَعْ لاَحَـد مِنَّا حُجَّةً وَلاَ عُذْراً
transliteration: wa lam yadaʿ lāḥadan minnā ḥujjatan walā ʿudhran
english_text: and left none of us with an argument or excuse.

arabic_text: فَالْهَالِكُ مِنَّا مَنْ هَلَكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ السَّعِيدُ مِنَّا مَنْرَغِبَ إلَيْهِ
transliteration: fala-hāliku minna man halaka ʿalayhi wa al-saʿeedu minna man raghiba ilayhi
english_text: So the perisher among us is he who perishes in spite of Him and the felicitous among us he who beseeches Him.

arabic_text: وَ الْحَمْد للهِ بِكُلِّ مَا حَمِدَهُ بِهِ أدْنَى مَلائِكَتِهِ إلَيْهِ وَ أَكْرَمُ خَلِيقَتِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَأرْضَىحَامِدِيْهِ لَدَيْهِ
transliteration: wa al-ḥamdu lillāhi bikulli mā ḥamidahu bihī adnaa malaa'ikatihi ilayhi wa akramu khalīqatihi ʿalayhi wa ardā ḥāmidīhi ladayhi
english_text: And praise belongs to God with all the praises of His angels closest to Him, His creatures most noble in His eyes, and His praisers most pleasing to Him;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يَفْضُلُ سَآئِرَ الْحَمْدِ كَفَضْلِ رَبِّنا عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِهِ
transliteration: ḥamdān yafḍulu sāʾira al-ḥamdi kafadl rabbinā ʿalā jamiʿi khalqih
english_text: a praise that may surpass other praises as our Lord surpasses all His creatures.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ مَكَانَ كُلِّ نِعْمَة لَهُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلى جَمِيعِ عِبَادِهِ الْمَاضِينَ وَالْبَاقِينَ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِالاشْيَآءِ
transliteration: thumma lahu al-ḥamd makāna kulli niʿmatin lahu ʿalaynā wa ʿala jamiʿi ʿibadihi al-madine wa al-baqine ʿadada mā ʾaḥāṭa bihī ʿilmuhu min jamiʿi al-ashyāʾi
english_text: Then to Him belongs praise, in place of His every favour upon us and upon all His servants, past and still remaining, to the number of all things His knowledge encompasses,

arabic_text: وَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ وَاحِدَة مِنْهَا عَدَدُهَا أَضْعافَاً مُضَاعَفَةً أَبَداً سَرْمَداً إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
transliteration: wa makanat kulli wahidatin minha 'adaduha. 'aḍʿāfan muḍā'afatan abadan sarmadan ilā yawm al-qiyāmah
english_text: and in place of each of His favours, their number doubling and redoubling always and forever, to the Day of Resurrection;

arabic_text: حَمْداً لاَ مُنْتَهَى لِحَدِّهِ وَ لا حِسَابَ لِعَدَدِهِ وَ لاَ مَبْلَغَ لِغَايَتِهِ وَ لا انْقِطَاعَ لاَمَدِهِ
transliteration: ḥamdan lā muntaḥā liḥaddihi wa la hisaba li'adadihi wa lā mablagha li-ghāyatihi wa lā inqitaʿa lā madhīh
english_text: a praise whose bound has no utmost end, whose number has no reckoning, whose limit cannot be reached, whose period cannot be cut off;

arabic_text: حَمْدَاً يَكُونُ وُصْلَةً إلَى طَاعَتِهِ وَعَفْوِهِ وَ سَبَباً إلَى رِضْوَانِهِ وَذَرِيعَةً إلَى مَغْفِرَتِهِ وَ طَرِيقاً إلَى جَنَّتِهِ
transliteration: ḥamdān yakūnu wuṣlatan ilā ṭāʿatihī waʿafwihī wa sababan ilā riḍwānih waḏariʿatan ilā maghfiratih wa ṭarīqan ilā jannatihi
english_text: a praise which will become a link to His obedience and pardon, a tie to His good pleasure, a means to His forgiveness, a path to His Garden,

arabic_text: وَخَفِيْراً مِنْ نَقِمَتِهِ وَ أَمْناً مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَ ظَهِيْراً عَلَى طَاعَتِهِ وَ حَاجِزاً عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِهِ
transliteration: wa khafirān min naqimatihi wa amnan min ghadabihi wa ẓahīran ʿalā ṭāʿatih wa ḥājizan ʿan maʿṣiyatihi
english_text: a protector against His vengeance, a security against His wrath, an aid to obeying Him, a barrier against disobeying Him,

arabic_text: وَعَوْناً عَلَى تَأدِيَةِ حَقِّهِ وَ وَظائِفِهِ
english_text: a help in fulfilling His right and His duties;

arabic_text: حَمْداً نَسْعَدُ بِهِ فِي السُّعَدَاءِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآئِهِ وَنَصِيرُ بِهِ فِي نَظْمِ الشُّهَدَآءِ بِسُيُوفِ أَعْدَائِهِ
transliteration: ḥamdan nasʿadu bihī fī al-suʿadāʾi min awliyāʾihi wa-naṣīru bihī fī naẓmi al-shuhadā'i bi-suyūfi a'adā'ihi
english_text: a praise that will make us felicitous among His felicitous friends, and bring us into the ranks of those martyred by the swords of His enemies.
